frictions.description: The auth cookie name is 'thumbfast.session_token' (using SiteConfig.appId prefix), not 'better-auth.session_token' as specified in the task prompt. Additionally, Better Auth uses signed cookies (HMAC-SHA-256 with BETTER_AUTH_SECRET), so the raw session token must be signed before setting as a cookie.
frictions.resolution: Discovered the cookie prefix from auth.ts config (cookiePrefix: SiteConfig.appId = 'thumbfast'), then generated the signed cookie value using Web Crypto HMAC-SHA-256 with the BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.

frictions.description: agent-browser 'click --button right' flag did not trigger a contextmenu event; it navigated instead. Had to use JavaScript MouseEvent dispatch to trigger right-click context menus.
frictions.resolution: Used eval to dispatch MouseEvent('contextmenu') on the card element directly.

summary: Tested 6 assertions: all 6 passed. ThumbnailCard context menus work correctly — dots button appears on hover, clicking it opens dropdown with Rename/Delete, right-click opens context menu with same options, rename dialog pre-fills current name and updates card, delete shows confirmation and removes card, and card click still navigates to detail page.
